correctness.rationale: The exact denominator formula was reconstructed. Rational comparisons certify 7 disjoint one-root Rouché discs and simplicity; real root residue exceeds 19, the three conjugate-pair residues are bounded by 15,5,1 with strictly larger moduli. An exact rational majorant is below 19 at n=32 and decreases thereafter. Exact rational recurrence certifies c_n>0 for n=0..31. These analytic steps prove all n; executable code was run from the material package. Limit: only q_{7,7}.

Exact seven-disc Rouché inequalities, strict residue separation, and rational first-32 checks are proved for [7/7]. value.rationale: The diagonal Padé denominator of degree seven is a natural widely relevant matrix exponential approximation order. Published work explicitly identifies the remaining diagonal conjecture after its broad off-diagonal refutation. This closes a motivated exact all-index case beyond the separately treated orders three and five and independently certifies a nontrivial pole-dominance property; it is not merely a finite coefficient list. This does not assert the complete diagonal conjecture or a new algorithmic runtime.
